sentences.text:
THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.K. SAHOO THE HON'BLE MISS. JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO Order No. ORDER 05.03.2025 02. This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer for direction to the opp. parties to take necessary action regarding consideration of the representation under Annexure-6, which is dated 15.10.2024 and re-estimate the quantum of the compensation amount as per the Govt. bench Mark Valuation and nearest vicinity area.

When the matter was taken up on 11.02.2025, learned counsel for the petitioners prayed for an adjournment to obtain necessary instruction as to whether any steps have been taken by the petitioners in terms of Signed by: RAJESH KUMAR BADHEI Designation: Junior Stenographer Reason: Authentication Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter 2013 Act).
On instruction, learned counsel for the petitioners submits

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: that such application has not been filed
and seeks permission to withdraw this writ petition in order to file an application under section 64 of the 2013 Act.
In view of such submissions, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge (Savitri Ratho) Judge Rajesh Sambhu Sing & Others vs State Of Odisha & on 5 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112198798/
